authority: Root coordinator retains production and shared-contract ownership; this report records code presence separately from production wiring and external gates.

findings.implementation: S1/S2 are called by the ordinary M15 composer; S3 has its own versioned research policy and native M1 diagnostics. Production inputs reject candidate policy hashes outside exact S1-S3 and reject pre-sized candidates.
findings.production_wiring: S1/S2 flow through multisleeve CandidateSet, selector, hard-risk sizing, frozen action and economic admission. Native M1 S3 intentionally emits a diagnostic-only NOT_ESTIMABLE CandidateSet because trade completeness is unproven; S3 setup is evaluated with empty residuals and no VWAP, so it cannot create candidates in this path.

evidence.claim: The production policy map is exactly S1/S2/S3 and candidate contract enforces it.
Native M1 path supplies no decision-affecting inputs and writes diagnostic-only terminal stages.
M15 generation invokes S1/S2; M1 path uses S3 diagnostic readiness and empty setup inputs.
Only selected candidate passes risk sizing and frozen action; evaluation is separately gated by complete causal economic inputs.

findings.missing_engineering: Ordinary event composition does not run S4-S8 research surfaces and cannot place their outputs in CandidateSet. Root-owned registration must preserve complete candidates, frozen selector and risk-only sizing. S3 remains gated on complete source trade evidence.
external_gates: Bybit complete trade-history/continuity evidence is unproven; S3 remains NOT_ESTIMABLE by design.

findings.topic: S4-S8 standalone modules versus production composition
findings.implementation: S4 microstructure feature/context types, S5 separately versioned continuation/reversal, S6 cross-sectional research coordinator, S7 deterministic event gates/alerts/directional shadow, and S8 research basket simulation exist with focused tests. S8 explicitly rejects conversion into a single-action plan.
findings.production_wiring: `production.py`, `public_context.py`, `product.py` and `research_model_shadow.py` contain no calls to the S4/S5/S6/S7 directional/S8 evaluation APIs. Production can consume typed S7 calendar/abnormality/incident prerequisites as deterministic gates; this is not directional S7 evaluation. PublicContext fetches one configured source per cadence and explicitly labels authentication/calendar coverage UNKNOWN.

evidence.claim: Continuation and reversal have separate versioned identities and research APIs.
S6 is a standalone coordinator, not wired by production composer.
Typed news collection, deterministic gate builder and directional shadow APIs exist.
S8 emits a ResearchBasketForecast and rejects CandidateAction/normal-plan conversion.
Bounded round-robin collection; accepted report keeps authentication and calendar coverage unknown.
Production reads typed schedule/coverage/abnormality/incident facts for prerequisite gates, not S7 directional reaction.

findings.missing_engineering: Add a typed orchestration seam that emits per-sleeve causal status/evidence while keeping S4 execution context and standalone shadow distinct, S5 continuation/reversal distinct, S6 shadow-only, S7 safety gates distinct from authenticated directional event shadow, and S8 basket-only. Root-owned production integration is still required.
external_gates: Configured source authentication, verified calendar coverage, asset mapping and timely public S4/S5 data are not established by module/test presence.

findings.implementation: Causal feature snapshot computes technical indicators, candle geometry, confirmed swing/structure/SR/Fibonacci/morphology and partial regime axes. Math primitives include robust slope, forward Kalman update, realized/EWMA variance, HAR, cutoff-filtered empirical residuals and common-path identities.
findings.production_wiring: Feature snapshots are built for the triggered key and passed to S1/S2; several frozen math axes and context families remain unbound or placeholders. Snapshot explicitly records anchored VWAP/volume profile and liquidity/crowding/event/OOD axes as missing. Model Arena statistical surface is separate.

evidence.claim: Exact causal bar checks and feature computations; unavailable trades are explicit.
Structure/morphology and trend/volatility state; external axes explicitly unbound.
Online math primitives and cutoff-scoped residual/common-path helpers.

findings.missing_engineering: Map each authorized math family to a named causal input/artifact and feature-family ablation; wire external flow/derivative/event axes only with exact evidence and missingness. No indicator voting.

findings.topic: M0/M1, analogue, scenarios, uncertainty and ES
findings.implementation: M0 fit, pretrade scenario generation, outcome/calibration/support/OOD uncertainty, deterministic stress, portfolio completeness and ES are implemented in the Phase-2 evaluator. M1 LightGBM is a separate diagnostic. Analogue estimator has a causal typed API. Production analogue path currently writes NOT_ESTIMABLE unconditionally; production M1 is post-receipt shadow only.
findings.production_wiring: For selected exact action only, Phase-2 runs when full cutoff-bound model/calibration/execution and portfolio/support evidence resolve; otherwise evaluation is NOT_ESTIMABLE. No candidate selection or risk sizing depends on M0/M1/analogue or model output.

evidence.claim: Caller-owned Phase-2 evaluation verifies selected sized action and begins M0 plus pretrade scenarios.
Production runs evaluator only with complete economic inputs, else persists NOT_ESTIMABLE.
M1 is a diagnostic; analogue is currently hard-coded NOT_ESTIMABLE.
Existing exact compatibility, causal query, matured observations and estimator interfaces are reusable.

findings.missing_engineering: Use exact matured compatible outcome refs to call analogue estimator and bind result to the same frozen action; preserve current terminal missingness when no support. Broader production auto-resolution of economic source templates is independently incomplete/conditional.
external_gates: Economic value remains NOT ESTIMABLE; final holdout remains unassigned/untouched.

findings.topic: Model Arena adapters and Discovery/critic amendments
findings.implementation: TiRex-2, Kronos-mini and Chronos-2 adapters/protocol/runtime are tested contract surfaces. Discovery lab and provider-neutral agent contracts exist. Session-029 action critic can be installed as an optional post-receipt shadow; it is not deterministic pipeline authority. Normal product post-receipt research shadow uses statistical route only. No S7 EventExtractionProvider runtime is wired.
findings.production_wiring: The S41 product runner composes StatisticalResearchShadow after receipts; optional critic is installed only when provider profile is enabled. No forecast adapter/model Arena route is part of the normal production action-evaluation route, and no production Discovery proposal or event-extraction task is scheduled.

evidence.claim: TiRex adapter contract exists.
Kronos-mini adapter contract exists.
Chronos-2 adapter contract exists.
Normal product composes statistical shadow and only optionally starts critic.
Receipt shadow runs a StatisticalResearchProvider route.
Discovery proposal first; critic post-numerical evaluation; event extraction separate; all zero authority.
Critic is one-call, tool-free, zero authority; live provider and prospective gates remain.

findings.missing_engineering: Model Arena request/forecast routing into normal research evaluation, deterministic statistical fallback policy, and Discovery/event-extraction scheduling remain unconnected. Critic already has the opt-in post-receipt seam; alias-only profile cannot qualify decision influence.
external_gates: Direct DeepSeek critic contract and prospective shadow are TEST GATE; model alias is not a fixed revision; no provider call was made for this audit.

Require typed NOT_ESTIMABLE artifacts with explicit reason and source refs for missing data; preserve S5 continuation/reversal identities and S7 gate versus directional-shadow separation.

Test every surface for cutoff chronology, missingness, source ref completeness, zero authority, and no selector/risk/action mutation; root-owned production tests must verify integration is disabled or zero-effect by default.
